title: Will Barack Obama be seen in public before Aug 1, 2026?

markets.title: Will Barack Obama be seen in public before Aug 1, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Barack Obama has been seen in public starting 10:00 AM Jul 1, 2026 and before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
All of the following criteria must be met:

Physical Presence: Barack Obama is physically present (not virtual/holographic) and alive
Consciousness: Barack Obama appears conscious and aware (not unconscious, comatose, or incapacitated)
Public Setting: The sighting occurs in one of the following:
   A public space accessible to the general public (streets, parks, shops, restaurants)
   A ticketed public event (concerts, sports events, conferences)
   An official public appearance (government events, ceremonies, press conferences)
   A semi-public venue where public access is normal (hotels, airports, train stations)

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

Pre-recorded or archival footage presented as current
Private events closed to the general public (private parties, closed meetings)
Medical facilities, private residences, or restricted areas
Virtual appearances (video calls, holograms, avatars)
Body doubles or impersonators
Corpses, funeral viewings, or posthumous footage

Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes:

Barack Obama attends a movie premiere and is photographed on the red carpet by multiple Source Agencies
Barack Obama gives a live press conference covered by news media
Barack Obama attends a sporting event and is shown on the stadium's video screens

Examples that would NOT resolve to Yes:

Pre-recorded video message
Private party footage leaked online
Someone claiming to be Barack Obama but without Source Agency confirmation
Barack Obama appearing via video link from home

Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods

Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.
